Deel.author: leonard

Deel.note: 32 of 35 Processed notices are Arthur then Leonard. The main runs from Sep 27 2023 sit within 5 days of month end. No amount, no fee, no count.

Leapblock.text: the saga map crew early on, Martin and Victor through them
Leapblock.note: Sept 2023 invoices and Nov 2 2023 approval list saga map, Martin, Victor together. No order claimed (sw2 L4). No amount, no wire date.

Leapblock.author: arthur
Leapblock.text: they invoiced at month end, the wire usually landed the month after, sometimes right at month end
Leapblock.note: Arthur approved 21 of 29 wires. Past tense: Leonard told them Feb 11 that January was the last payment.

Leapblock.author: leonard
Leapblock.text: external art studio, they billed us for the people they had on our work
Leapblock.note: Robert's own Dec 2023 mail describes Leapblock as the external art studio they work with. No amount, no statement.

Leapblock.author: leonard
Leapblock.text: wider saga map team wrapped in Jun 2024, Victor left Apr 2025, Martin paid through Jan 2026
Leapblock.note: 'no further payments for the broader saga map team'; 'His last day was April 16th'; 'We paid him until end of January'. Dates of people, not of wires. Nothing about Sep 2023.

Adjoe.author: leonard

MotMot.author: arthur

MotMot.author: leonard
MotMot.text: I always just approved what Blake put in
MotMot.note: All 11 BANCO notices are Arthur then Leonard (sw2 L8).

MotMot.author: arthur
MotMot.text: one of their engineers on our team, I set it up with them in early 2024
MotMot.note: Feb 27 2024: 'The MotMot guys want to know if we are ok if ... only does 3 days a week', Arthur sets the rate. No date of any payment.

MotMot.author: arthur
MotMot.text: I waited for his day count each month before running it, so it usually went out after the month or right at the end of it
MotMot.note: 'Getting how many extra days ... then I can do MotMot', 'wait on MotMot payment until we know the number of hours', 'pay motmot for May'. Nothing on April, account or return.

Singular.author: leonard
Singular.note: SDK in the Jan 2024 app and set up again for a second app in Mar 2025. Names no game.

Singular.author: leonard
Singular.text: yearly deal from Sep 2024, in 2025 I wanted it quarterly because the yearly hit hurt
Singular.note: '1 year that's fine', 'that's what we agreed on', Jul 2025 'I'll ask next month for Singular to do this quarterly or monthly'. Says wanted, not agreed. No amount, no invoice number, nothing on the unpaid bill.

Singular.author: arthur
Singular.text: it went in more than one app, I put the keys in for the second one
Singular.note: 'can you send me the Singular keys I need to put in the app'; Leonard asks Arthur to check the SDK in Jan 2024. Names no game.

Node Media.author: leonard
Node Media.text: one payment when we closed the account, Jan 2025

Node Media.author: leonard
Node Media.text: they were late with invoices so several months of 2024 went out at once
Node Media.note: Their Nov 2024 mail, forwarded to Robert, says no invoices had gone out yet; Leonard says '3+ months payment'. No figure, no service named.

TYZ Law Group.author: leonard

Trademark lawyer.author: leonard

Trademark lawyer.note: 'it's for the trademark application of the Harmony Games logo and brand'. Silent on the second mark, so no game is named.

Trademark lawyer.author: leonard

Trademark lawyer.note: 'Section 2(d) ... Partial Refusal', 'trademark follow up lawyer work'. Silent on the 2025 wire, whose purpose is only inferred.
